$schema_notes: Curated subset of ACC/AHA guideline recommendations used by the rule-based planner. Every rule emits its `recommendation_text` verbatim along with the citation. The planner does not paraphrase. To add a rule, append an object with the schema below. preconditions are evaluated by app/planner.py against the patient's problem list, meds, labs, and imaging.

problem_match: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
rules.recommendation_text: In patients with HFrEF, replacement of an ACE inhibitor or ARB with an angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitor (ARNI; sacubitril/valsartan) is recommended to further reduce morbidity and mortality.
rules.rationale_for_patient: ARNI is a foundational GDMT pillar in HFrEF and is preferred over ACEi/ARB when tolerated.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
citation.section: Recommendations for Renin-Angiotensin System Inhibition in HFrEF

problem_match: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
rules.recommendation_text: In patients with HFrEF, use of one of the three beta blockers proven to reduce mortality (bisoprolol, carvedilol, or sustained-release metoprolol succinate) is recommended.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Evidence-based beta blockers reduce mortality in HFrEF.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
citation.section: Recommendations for Beta Blockers in HFrEF

problem_match: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
rules.recommendation_text: In patients with HFrEF and LVEF ≤35%, a mineralocorticoid receptor antagonist (spironolactone or eplerenone) is recommended to reduce morbidity and mortality, provided eGFR ≥30 mL/min/1.73 m² and serum potassium ≤5.0 mEq/L.
rules.rationale_for_patient: MRAs are a GDMT pillar in HFrEF when renal function and potassium permit.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure

problem_match: Heart Failure with Reduced Ejection Fraction
rules.recommendation_text: In patients with symptomatic chronic HFrEF, an SGLT2 inhibitor is recommended to reduce hospitalization for heart failure and cardiovascular mortality, irrespective of the presence of type 2 diabetes.
rules.rationale_for_patient: SGLT2 inhibitors are a GDMT pillar; benefit is independent of diabetes status.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/HFSA Guideline for the Management of Heart Failure
citation.section: Recommendations for SGLT2 Inhibitors in HFrEF

rules.recommendation_text: In patients with AF and an elevated risk of stroke (e.g., CHA₂DS₂-VASc score ≥2 in men or ≥3 in women), oral anticoagulation is recommended. For patients without moderate-to-severe rheumatic mitral stenosis or a mechanical heart valve, DOACs are recommended over warfarin.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Stroke prevention is the cornerstone of AF management when CHA₂DS₂-VASc-based risk is elevated.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
citation.section: Recommendations for Stroke Risk Assessment and Antithrombotic Therapy

rules.recommendation_text: Continue oral anticoagulation for stroke prevention in AF with elevated CHA₂DS₂-VASc; DOACs are preferred over warfarin in eligible patients.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Anticoagulation is appropriately in place; continue and reassess bleeding risk periodically.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA/ACCP/HRS Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
citation.section: Recommendations for Stroke Risk Assessment and Antithrombotic Therapy

rules.recommendation_text: In patients with clinical ASCVD, high-intensity statin therapy is recommended with the aim of achieving ≥50% reduction in LDL-C.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Secondary prevention requires high-intensity statin therapy for ASCVD risk reduction.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol

rules.recommendation_text: In very high-risk ASCVD patients with LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin therapy, it is reasonable to add ezetimibe; if LDL-C remains ≥70 mg/dL on maximally tolerated statin and ezetimibe, addition of a PCSK9 monoclonal antibody is reasonable.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Stepwise non-statin therapy reduces LDL-C and ASCVD events in very high-risk patients.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol

rules.recommendation_text: In adults with confirmed hypertension and known CVD or 10-year ASCVD risk ≥10%, a BP target of <130/80 mm Hg is recommended.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Tighter BP control reduces CV events in higher-risk hypertensive patients.

citation.guideline: ACC/AHA Guideline for the Prevention, Detection, Evaluation, and Management of High Blood Pressure in Adults

rules.recommendation_text: In patients with chronic coronary disease, low-dose aspirin 81 mg daily is recommended for secondary prevention to reduce atherothrombotic events.
rules.rationale_for_patient: Lifelong antiplatelet therapy reduces recurrent MI and stroke in chronic coronary disease.

citation.guideline: AHA/ACC Guideline for the Management of Patients With Chronic Coronary Disease
